description: This file defines a PHP class for interfacing with Microsoft SQL Server using the ADO database abstraction layer. It includes methods for creating sequences, retrieving insert IDs, managing transactions, and fetching table metadata, specific to the MS SQL Server driver implementation.

classes.name: ADODB_ado_mssql
classes.description: A class that provides Microsoft SQL Server specific implementations for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP, including SQL dialect modifications and transaction management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado_mssql
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_ado to handle record set operations specifically for MS SQL Server within the ADOdb framework.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value using SQL Server's SCOPE_IDENTITY().

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query using @@rowcount.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for subsequent database operations.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in a SQL query, handling null bytes.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Fetches metadata about the columns of a specified table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence (auto-incrementing counter) in the database.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates the next ID in a sequence, creating it if it doesn't exist.
